## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与结果

What changes for a user, and why? Keep application payload behavior separate from injector behavior.

## Scope / 影响范围

Affected execution domain, backend, host/resource layout, CLI contract, documentation, or manuscript claims. State any new access requirements or unsupported cases.

## Validation / 验证

Commands and results, including relevant versions. For research or compatibility claims, link the exact evidence/run and distinguish fixtures from real applications. List material limitations; do not include session keys or user content.
